content.comment_body: Communication is not working between the controller and the operator panel, so I can't view variables or control outputs. I followed the tutorial video step by step but still no success. [url]

This is very limited information. Please provide more details: Which controller model are you using? Please list the full [article_no]. Which software version do you have? Let us know the IP address and subnet mask for the controller and the operator panel, and specify which HMI model you have. Also, please upload your software diagram as a ZIP file.
Have you enabled 'Allow S7 access' in the controller settings to allow communication with your operator panel?
'I enabled access as well but still not receiving an IP.'
Hello [user_name], please use English in this forum. Thank you. Translation: Not enough information. We need more details from you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering ongoing problems establishing communication between the controller and operator panel using [product_name] software. Variables are not updating and outputs aren't controllable, even after following tutorials and enabling communication options. This suggests possible configuration mistakes, compatibility problems, or network setup issues.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects simple and effective real-time communication between the controller and operator panel for monitoring and control, assuming all setup instructions are followed.
